integrity: A finite exact checker supports, but does not replace, the analytic proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: No bound is claimed for general multi-harmonic target data.
The proof establishes exact algebraic limits, not noise stability.
Absolute bibliographic priority is not independently established.
scientific_scope: Exact one-harmonic radial squared-modulus inversion for complex polynomials with weight t^beta (beta>-1), arbitrary frequency, degree, phase and strict positive target.
title: Sharp polynomial degree barriers for one-harmonic radial holomorphic intensity inversion
